action_executions_verification_timestamp.name: action_executions_verification_timestamp_ck
action_executions_verification_timestamp.value:
("action_executions"."verification_status" = 'pending' and "action_executions"."verified_at" is null)
        or ("action_executions"."verification_status" <> 'pending' and "action_executions"."verified_at" is not null)

connections_principal_pair_ck.name: connections_principal_pair_ck
connections_principal_pair_ck.value:
("connections"."external_principal_type" is null and "connections"."external_principal_id" is null)
        or ("connections"."external_principal_type" is not null and "connections"."external_principal_id" is not null)

runs_trigger_binding_pair_ck.name: runs_trigger_binding_pair_ck
runs_trigger_binding_pair_ck.value:
("runs"."trigger_connection_id" is null and "runs"."trigger_integration_key" is null)
        or ("runs"."trigger_connection_id" is not null and "runs"."trigger_integration_key" is not null)

runs_replay_lineage_ck.name: runs_replay_lineage_ck
runs_replay_lineage_ck.value:
("runs"."mode" = 'replay' and "runs"."replay_of_run_id" is not null)
        or ("runs"."mode" <> 'replay' and "runs"."replay_of_run_id" is null)

runs_finished_after_started_ck.name: runs_finished_after_started_ck
runs_finished_after_started_ck.value:
"runs"."finished_at" is null
        or "runs"."started_at" is null
        or "runs"."finished_at" >= "runs"."started_at"

auth_account_credential_only_ck.name: auth_account_credential_only_ck
auth_account_credential_only_ck.value:
"auth_account"."provider_id" = 'credential'
        and "auth_account"."account_id" = "auth_account"."user_id"
        and "auth_account"."password" is not null
        and "auth_account"."access_token" is null
        and "auth_account"."refresh_token" is null
        and "auth_account"."id_token" is null
        and "auth_account"."access_token_expires_at" is null
        and "auth_account"."refresh_token_expires_at" is null
        and "auth_account"."scope" is null
